# Dias Accounting and Tax Consulting LLC

> FTA-Registered Tax Agency in the UAE, founded by FTA-Registered Tax Agent Glen Dias. Fixed-fee monthly IFRS accounting, 5% VAT filings, 9% Corporate Tax compliance, and DIFC/DTEC statutory audits from AED 400/month.

## Firm Overview
- **Firm Name**: Dias Accounting and Tax Consulting LLC
- **Regulatory Status**: FTA-Registered Tax Agency in the United Arab Emirates
- **Founder & Managing Partner**: Glen Dias (FTA-Registered Tax Agent & Chartered Tax Advisor)
- **Headquarters**: Sharjah Media City (SHAMS), Al Messaned, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates
- **Areas Served**: Dubai Mainland, DIFC, DTEC, IFZA, DMCC, Sharjah (SHAMS / SAIF Zone), Abu Dhabi, and all UAE Emirates (remote & on-site)

## Transparent Starting Pricing & Fixed-Fee Retainers
- **Monthly IFRS Accounting & Bookkeeping + 5% VAT Form 201 + 9% Corporate Tax**: Starting from **AED 400/month** (fixed-fee retainers, zero hidden hourly fees)
- **UAE Corporate Tax Registration & 0% Small Business Relief (up to AED 3M revenue)**: Fixed-fee EmaraTax registration and annual filing (0% SBR extended through 31 December 2029)
- **DIFC & DTEC 0% QFZP Compliance & Dividend Distribution Audits**: Specialized Qualifying Free Zone Person (0% CT) substance & de minimis compliance, connected-person schedules, and statutory interim/final dividend distribution audits
- **Backlog Bookkeeping & Ledger Reconstruction**: Fixed-fee multi-year IFRS cleanup and opening balance restoration

## Free Interactive UAE Tax Tools
- **2026 UAE Corporate Tax & 5% VAT Calculator**: [https://diasuae.ae/uae-tax-planner](https://diasuae.ae/uae-tax-planner)
  - Supports **Mainland** (`0%` up to AED 375,000, `9%` above AED 375,000, and `0%` Small Business Relief up to AED 3,000,000 revenue)
  - Supports **Free Zone** (`0%` Qualifying Free Zone Person QFZP, live `5% / AED 5M` De Minimis test, and `9%` on non-qualifying taxable profit)
  - Includes a **5% UAE VAT & Input Recovery Calculator** (Add/Extract 5% VAT and FTA Form 201 reclaimability check across 8 business expense categories)
